findings.effect: The SSE contract comment still describes done as carrying only turnId and usage, although it can now also carry truncated.
findings.reason: The SSE contract comment omits the optional truncated field now emitted in done payloads.

findings.effect: The spec omits the tool-call part that the real provider sends for a cut-off tool call, so it covers a stream shape production cannot reach. With the real stream shape, raw JSON parser text reaches the pro as a tool error and is stored for the model to read on the next turn.
findings.reason: The installed Anthropic adapter emits the incomplete tool-call input, which the SDK converts into a parser tool-error that the backend exposes and persists, but the spec omits that event.

findings.effect: The backend adds a truncated flag but no visible English or Spanish message for a cut-off turn. Unless the frontend reads that flag and displays a message, the turn remains silent.
findings.reason: The backend exposes truncation through both SSE and persisted message metadata, allowing the frontend to display localized text; absent backend prose does not establish a silent UI.

findings.effect: The backend marks a cut-off turn as truncated but does not provide the requested en/es message. An empty cut-off turn remains silent unless the frontend displays a message from the flag.
findings.reason: Localized display can be handled by the frontend using the exposed truncated flag, so the model client's lack of English or Spanish prose is not itself a defect.
